jobs.title: Registered Nurse - AI ChatBot Reviewer (US, Remote)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking experienced US registered nurses to review and assess AI-generated responses from a health coaching agent, with a focus on safety, regulatory compliance, and clinical content accuracy. You will work asynchronously on a dedicated review platform, performing short, structured evaluations to help train and refine AI models for patient-facing health guidance. This is a remote, flexible and short-term project. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Structured Grading: Score AI agent responses against a pre-defined rubric, applying the highest-priority criteria consistently across a large volume of items. - Safety Review: Identify responses that could cause patient harm missed red flags, unsafe advice, failure to escalate or signpost to care. - Clinical Accuracy: Assess factual correctness, completeness and guideline alignment of clinical content. - Written Feedback: Provide brief, specific rationale for each failed response and general guidance on how it could be improved. QUALIFICATIONS - Licensure: Active RN license for US - Experience: Minimum 2 years of clinical nursing practice. - Knowledge: Strong grounding in clinical guidelines, patient safety and scope-of-practice boundaries. - Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in clinical documentation or review work. - Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured review tools and digital platforms. - Language: Native or near-native written English. jobs.title: Physician - Clinical AI Expert (Remote)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking physicians to review, validate and design clinical tasks to help advance frontier AI models across a range of clinical scenarios and formats. The project is designed to surface where models perform poorly in clinical scenarios such missed findings, incorrect clinical information, overconfidence or failure to seek context before answering. You will work asynchronously on a dedicated platform, within your own specialty and day-to-day scope of practice. This is a remote, flexible and short-term project. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Scenario Design: Design realistic clinical scenarios and instructions that mirror the work you carry out day-to-day in your specialty. - Content Review: Assess clinical outputs for accuracy, flagging anything incorrect, outdated or can cause harm. - Reference Answer Validation: Judge whether reference answers reflect what you would actually write in practice, including caveats, uncertainty and requests for further information. - Grading Criteria Assessment: Design and evaluate whether scoring criteria capture what matters clinically and whether each is weighted appropriately, particularly safety-critical items. - Written Rationale: Provide short, specific reasoning where you disagree, and note the weakness each new item is designed to expose. - Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Highlight edge cases and ambiguity to refine guidelines and improve consistency across reviewers. jobs.title: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (USA)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines. You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models. This is a remote, flexible and short-term project. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule. - Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion. - Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn. - Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies. - Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined. This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions. Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description_text:
Nanopath is developing a first-in-class in vitro diagnostics platform to transform how diseases are diagnosed. We aim to replace lengthy molecular testing workflows by bringing rapid, high-quality diagnostics closer to the patient. Our mission is to improve patient outcomes – starting with women – through a purpose-built platform that delivers actionable results within a single office visit.

The company is headquartered at The Engine, the premier tough technology incubator in the Kendall Square ecosystem. We are collectively committed to health equity and the design of solutions for underserved populations and low-resource settings. Corporate sustainability – both environmental and social – is at the forefront of our decision making.

About the Role

The Clinical Operations Manager will play a critical role in the planning, execution, and oversight of Nanopath’s clinical studies. This role combines strategic clinical operations leadership with hands-on operational execution, supporting study start-up, site initiation, monitoring, and ongoing study management.

This individual will be joining at an exciting time in Nanopath’s trajectory, and will be responsible for our pilot studies as well as our pivotal study in support of FDA clearance.

This is an in-person, full-time salaried position.

We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

Team Description:

At Neuralink, safety isn't a checkpoint, it's what lets us move fast without breaking the people who build the future. The Safety Team is the tactical extension of our engineers and scientists, embedding directly into high-stakes labs and facilities to eliminate hazards before they slow anyone down. We own the programs that protect our people, visitors, and contractors, and we run them at the pace the mission demands. We're looking for a high-speed, high-ownership individual who runs toward problems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants their work to directly enable Neuralink's mission of building a brain interface that restores autonomy and unlock human potential. 

Job Description and Responsibilities:

As an Environmental Health and Safety Specialist / Engineer at Neuralink, you will support and help drive the day-to-day functions of the Safety Team across our two California locations — South San Francisco and Fremont — as well as other functions throughout the company. This is a role for a highly motivated person who has deliberately chosen EHS as their career, or an experienced technical lead

jobs.description_text: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead. At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities. The Role We are in search of exceptional product marketing talent to help us promote highly scalable, true multitenant cloud solutions that are significantly impacting life sciences. Our focus is on customer satisfaction, employee success, and growth. The Product Marketing Manager / Senior Manager - Clinical Operations will be responsible for driving content and messaging for 1-3 products within the Clinical Operations portfolio. This person will support marketing and sales enablement activities across the customer lifecycle and collaborate closely with other marketing functions, product strategy, sales, and more.
